_why: Titles the databases cannot reach from the shelf's own wording: a slash, a parenthetical, or a Spanish title that is not even an alias on the item. Only the *identifier* is supplied here — every fact still comes from the source, because a runtime typed from memory is exactly the kind of invention the review step exists to stop.
